| tuning_min | **0.431** | 0.051 |
| lockbox_mean | 1.793 | **1.793** |
| lockbox_min | 1.134 | **1.347** |
| fold14_mdd | **-9.31%** | -9.97% |
| worst_mdd | **-9.31%** | -11.18% |

## Observations

1. **Champion retains crown** - Higher tuning mean and better drawdown profile
2. **Candidate shows promise** - Better lockbox_min (1.35 vs 1.13) suggests improved tail robustness on out-of-sample
3. **Trade-off**: Candidate sacrifices ~14% tuning performance for ~19% improvement in lockbox worst-case

## Recommended Next Steps

Execute the provided commands in sequence:

```bash
# 1. Run AUB autopilot - select best module candidates
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_autopilot.py \
    --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml \
    --run --select-best

# 2. Run system-level experiments
python3 experiment_system/tools/system_autopilot.py \
    --spec experiment_system/config/system_candidates.yaml \
    --run

# 3. Generate next fix report
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_next_fix.py \
    --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml \
    --output baseline/reports/next_fix.md
```

## Status
✅ Ready to proceed | No blocking issues | No INCONCLUSIVE experiments pending
